codeOfConduct.intro: Kvintet is a place for people who want to meet and learn from each other. To keep it pleasant for everyone, we follow a few simple rules.
codeOfConduct.reportIntro: Report a broken rule or a problem with a specific person to <email>{{email}}</email>.
codeOfConduct.reportStep1: We read every report and confirm that we received it.
codeOfConduct.reportStep2: We find out what happened and, depending on how serious it is, warn the person or restrict their access to the app.
codeOfConduct.reportStep3: Reports are handled in confidence. We do not reveal who made the report.
codeOfConduct.rule1: Treat others with respect. No insults, mockery or discrimination.
codeOfConduct.rule2: Be honest. Give true information about yourself and do not pretend to be someone else.
codeOfConduct.rule3: Protect others' privacy. Do not share anyone's personal data or group messages without their consent.
codeOfConduct.rule4: No spam or advertising. Offers and messages should relate to the community.
codeOfConduct.rule5: Keep your commitments. If you cannot make a meeting, let the others know in time.
codeOfConduct.title: Code of conduct

landing.caption: No photos, no ratings – just people and topics.
landing.heroText: Kvintet seats five people at one table who can learn something from each other. You pick the group by topic, not by who you already know.
landing.step1Text: Your role, what you can teach and what you want to learn. Tags, no photos.
landing.step2Text: You see every group that fits you – roles and interests, names stay hidden until the group forms.
landing.step3Text: With five members it forms on its own. With three or four, when everyone votes yes. Then the group chat opens.
